# Google Play: choose one path

1. Establish the app/package and requested action. For releases also establish
   track, source version and rollout scope; ask only for unresolved decisions.
   Upload/build permission does not authorize submission or production rollout.
2. Check available authenticated browser/API/EAS access before promising action.
   Reuse the active Console page; never request secrets in chat or log them.
3. Load only the procedure needed:
   - AAB build/upload/release: [release](./references/release.md).
   - Listing, screenshots, policy/forms/settings: [Console edits](./references/console.md).
   Load both only when the user requests both.
4. Treat repository status notes as historical, not proof of live Console state.
   Consult current official documentation only for the API/policy in question.
5. Never invent legal declarations, weaken checks or mark unknown compliance
   answers as passed. Account eligibility, data-provider rights, privacy and
   testing blockers remain blockers. Identity/payment/secret entry is user-owned.

Return actual saved/uploaded/submitted/rollout state, relevant links and blockers;
these are distinct outcomes. Do not claim approval or availability without proof.
